column1: # Flash layout for Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V2 and V3 (both 8 MB flash).
# ltcfg holds the packed device config written by `lora-tracker flash-config`.
# Its offset/size must match CONFIG_FLASH_OFFSET / CONFIG_PARTITION_SIZE in proto/src/config.rs
# (the CLI tests check this). Reflashing firmware does not touch ltcfg. Its subtype is
# "undefined" because espflash rejects custom numeric data subtypes like 0x40.
# The first sector of nvs (0x9000) holds the firmware's boot counter (firmware/src/storage.rs).
